Name: BetterShopAuctionForestWoodUI
Description: Forest Wood UI override pack for BetterShopAuction. Adds custom oak / pine / moss / leaf textures (containers, buttons, separators) and the .ui files referencing them. When installed alongside the main BetterShopAuction plugin, this pack overrides the vanilla game-asset look with a warm forest theme — carved wood frames, mossy slot trims, leafy accents, soft greens and browns. Remove this plugin to fall back to vanilla styling. Conflicts with other UI theme packs (Modern, Medieval) — install only one theme at a time.
